create_MountainCar_environment: create a MountainCar environment instance with custom max_steps and seed parameters
run_MountainCar_reset: run the MountainCar reset method to initialize position in range [-0.6, -0.4] with zero velocity
run_MountainCar_step: run a step in the MountainCar environment by passing an action integer 0, 1, or 2
review_MountainCar_observation_spec: review the MountainCar observation_spec method that returns a (1,3) float32 array spec
review_MountainCar_action_spec: review the MountainCar action_spec method that returns a DiscreteArray with 3 discrete actions
